import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from skilltest.worksheet import _render
root=Path('/private/tmp/skilltest-sol-low-pilot.Lunoau')
rows=[('dr-01','dr-02/no-dd','PASS'),('dr-02','dr-02/current-dd','PASS'),('lp-01','lp-01/no-dd','FAIL'),('lp-02','lp-01/current-dd','PASS')]
report=[]
for label,scenario,verdict in rows:
 attempt=root/'attempts'/label
 bundle=Path((attempt/'command-stdout.txt').read_text().strip())
 record=json.loads((bundle/'result.json').read_text())
 path='skill-validation/pilot/'+scenario
 rubric=hashlib.sha256((Path(path)/'rubric.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 generated=_render(path,rubric,record)
 filled=(attempt/'worksheet.md').read_text()
 assert [l for l in filled.splitlines() if l.startswith('#')]==[l for l in generated.splitlines() if l.startswith('#')]
 # All generated mechanical rows, empty infrastructure slots and table headers survive.
 mechanical=generated.split('## Semantic behavior')[0].splitlines()
 for line in mechanical:
  if line.startswith('| Scenario purpose |') or line.startswith('| Provider CLI version |'): continue
  assert line in filled,(label,line)
 for field in ['Scenario purpose','Provider CLI version','Overall verdict','Rationale','Disposition','Ambiguities','Scenario defects','Proposed methodology changes']:
  assert not f'| {field} |  |' in filled,(label,field)
 assert f'| Overall verdict | {verdict} |' in filled
 assessment=filled.split('## Semantic behavior')[1]
 assert not re.search(r'^\|(?:  \|){2,}$',assessment,re.M)
 assert 'codex-cli 0.153.4' in filled
 for u in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',filled+(attempt/'result.md').read_text()):
  target=u.split('#',1)[0]
  if target: assert (attempt/target).exists(),(label,u)
 result=json.loads((attempt/'verification.json').read_text())
 assert result['exit_code']==0
 audit=json.loads(result['output'])
 assert audit['mechanical_audit']=='PASS' and audit['run_id']==record['run_id']
 assert not Path(audit['private_runtime']).exists()
 if label.startswith('dr'):
  assert (bundle/'final.txt').read_text().splitlines()==(bundle/'workspace/evidence/deadline-note.md').read_text().splitlines()
 report.append(dict(label=label,run_id=record['run_id'],verdict=verdict,rubric_sha256=rubric,mechanical_fields_preserved=True,worksheet_complete=True,links_exist=True,runtime_absent=True))
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
